metadata.title: Thank You - Erase Horseracing India
metadata.description: Thank you for signing the pledge to end horse racing in India.

hero.title: Thank You for Your Pledge!
hero.subtitle: You've joined thousands of compassionate people standing up for horses. Together, we will end this cruelty.

cards.title: Spread the Word
cards.text: Share this campaign with friends and family. The more people who pledge, the stronger our movement becomes.

cards.title: Stay Updated
cards.text: We'll send you updates on our progress, upcoming actions, and ways you can help create change.
